Name: EBAGI - Vanilla Tweaks Icons
Author: jellyluvr29
Description:
[center][/center][left]This is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21437]Vanilla Tweaks[/url]﻿ pack for [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods[/url], the update for BAGI. This matches the Vanilla Tweaks icons to the redesigned EBAGI sprites.

[b]Installation
[/b][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods[/url]﻿ ﻿
[*]Unpack Vanilla Tweaks EBAGI pack into mod folder
[/list][url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases][/url]﻿
[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia More Flowers[/url] update has been added! Thank you to the lovely [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/PlepArts]PlepArts[/url]﻿ for letting me use their mod as a base for mine.﻿
[/list]
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/melonuwu?gameId=1303]Melonuwu[/url] has created a Cornucopia More Crops [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37245]version[/url], please check it out!﻿﻿
